feat(embedding): support OpenAI-compatible providers via OPENAI_BASE_URL (#76)
commits.body:
## Summary

Adds configurable base URL support to the OpenAI embedding provider so
users can point at **any OpenAI-compatible API** (OpenRouter, LiteLLM,
vLLM, Azure, etc.) with just env vars — no code changes needed.

- Added `base_url` param to `OpenAIEmbeddingProvider`, wired through
from `OPENAI_BASE_URL` env var
- The `dimensions` request parameter is **only sent to OpenAI's own
API** (`api.openai.com`) — most compatible providers don't support it,
so it's omitted for custom base URLs
- Provider name reflects the endpoint: `openai:model` vs
`openai-compatible:model`
- Documented in ENVIRONMENT_VARIABLES.md, README, CLAUDE.md,
INSTALLATION.md, and .env.example

### Usage

```bash
EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=openai
OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-or-v1-your-key
OPENAI_BASE_URL=https://openrouter.ai/api/v1
EMBEDDING_MODEL=openai/text-embedding-3-small
VECTOR_SIZE=768
```

## Test plan

- [x] All 120 existing unit tests pass
- [x] New tests: `test_openai_provider_initialization_with_base_url` —
verifies `base_url` passthrough to SDK
- [x] New tests:
`test_openai_provider_omits_dimensions_for_compatible_provider` —
verifies `dimensions` kwarg is omitted for non-OpenAI URLs
- [x] New tests: `test_is_openai_native_detection` — verifies URL
detection logic
- [x] Pre-commit hooks pass (black, isort, flake8, conventional commit)
- [ ] Manual test with OpenRouter (or other compatible provider) if
someone has a key

Closes #70

commits.headline: Support client-side STT transcripts and hybrid mode
commits.body: Accept on-device transcripts from clients and bypass server VAD/STT when appropriate. Adds a socket handler for 'transcript:user' (accepts string or {text}), logs the transcript, emits a 'transcript:delta' event and queues a hybrid user turn. initializeVoiceProvider now detects session.metadata.client.localSTT and, unless forced, skips VAD/STT initialization: marks the session ready, sets provider to 'client-local-stt', stubs voiceConnection, and emits 'openai:connected' with client-side STT/VAD info (using _hybridTtsProvider() or fallback). This enables clients (e.g. iOS Speech.framework) to perform STT locally and route text directly to the assistant.

commits.headline: fix(voice): correct sample rate mismatch and emit assistant transcript
commits.body:
getEffectiveSampleRate() returned hardcoded 16kHz but all TTS providers
output 24kHz. Clients interpreted audio at wrong rate → deep voice + cutoff.

Server:
- Split audio.sampleRate into inputSampleRate (16kHz) + outputSampleRate (24kHz)
- getEffectiveSampleRate() now returns 24kHz (matches Cartesia/ElevenLabs)
- session:ready includes inputSampleRate for mic capture
- Emit transcript:done with role:assistant after Claude response completes

Web:
- VoiceInput.jsx: decouple mic (16kHz) from playback (24kHz) rate
- audio-engine.js: same decoupling for newer AudioEngine class

commits.headline: fix(voice): correct sample rate mismatch causing deep/cut-off audio
commits.body:
Server TTS (Cartesia/ElevenLabs) outputs 24kHz PCM but session:ready
reported 16kHz. Client interpreted 24kHz as 16kHz → 2/3 speed playback
(deep voice) and buffer overflow (audio cutoff).

- Default targetRate to 24kHz (matches actual TTS output)
- Add dedicated micRate (16kHz) for mic capture, decoupled from playback
- processInputBuffer() now uses fixed 16kHz mic format
- Increase maxPlaybackBufferedSeconds from 0.75s to 2.0s
- Bump prebuffer threshold from 0.15s to 0.20s

commits.headline: fix: agent lifecycle hardening — stale detection, Slack notifications, status alignment
commits.body:
Three interconnected problems fixed:

1. Slack context never reached agents: service.js passed platform context as
   `platformContext` but agent-delegation.js read `callContext.slack`. Added
   `slack: ctx` to both delegation callsites so completion messages, questions,
   and progress updates can route back to Slack threads.

2. Agent questions/progress only posted to web, not Slack: sendStatusUpdate()
   only had `isChat` handlers. Added parallel Slack handlers for questions
   (thread reply with options), progress updates (every 5 rounds), and
   progress notes — following the existing present_plan Slack pattern.

3. Zombie running tasks with no detection:
   - Added stale reaper (5-min interval) that transitions stale running tasks
     (>15 min no activity) to interrupted and expires awaiting_input tasks
     (>4 hours) to cancelled.
   - Added execution timeout via AbortController (AGENT_TIMEOUT_MS, default 5m).
   - Enhanced recoverOrphanedTasks to also clean ancient pending/awaiting_input.
   - Fixed VALID_STATUSES in agent_status_query tool (was missing interrupted,
     awaiting_input, needs_input, queued).
   - Added stale flag, cancel_stale action, and proper thresholds.
   - Added explicit checkAgentStatus handlers for needs_input, pending,
     cancelled with staleness indicator for running tasks.

Also fixed pre-existing lint errors in touched files (catch(_) → catch,
unused var prefixing, empty block comments).

New files:
- tools/agent-status.js: MCP tool for querying agent status with stale detection
- src/db/agent-queries.js: Safe parameterized query layer for agent_runs

Env vars:
- AGENT_STALE_THRESHOLD_MS (default 900000 = 15 min)
- AGENT_INPUT_TIMEOUT_MS (default 14400000 = 4 hours)
- AGENT_STALE_REAPER_INTERVAL_MS (default 300000 = 5 min)
- AGENT_TIMEOUT_MS (default 300000 = 5 min, was documented but not wired)

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

commits.headline: Add welcome screen & enhance realtime voice UI
commits.body:
Introduce a friendly WelcomeScreen shown when a conversation is empty and improve realtime voice UX across the chat app. Key changes:

- Add WelcomeScreen component and show it in ChatInterface when there are no messages and not streaming.
- Refactor ChatInterface realtime event handler to use useCallback, simplify streaming transcript handling, clear buffers, and reduce noisy logging; wire WelcomeScreen and voice-related props.
- Update MessageInput to add an inline mic button, voice connection/active state props, subtle hint text, and support starting push-to-talk or continuous voice mode; tweak layout and disabled/send logic.
- Enhance MessageList to visually mark realtime voice messages (icon, subtle glow and "via voice" label).
- Replace VoiceStatusBar with a richer implementation: connecting state, nicer visuals, animated status icons, mute/end controls, and an AudioWaveform visualization (accepts analyserNode). Add related CSS animations.
- Update useRealtimeVoice hook to track isConnecting, set voicePhase to include connecting, fix mute toggle to avoid stale closures, and expose isConnecting in the returned state.
- Add CSS for voice-mode transitions, glow and waveform animations.

Overall this changeset consolidates voice controls into the input area, improves realtime feedback (connecting/listening/processing), and provides a clearer first-run experience.

commits.headline: Add realtime transcribe-only voice mode & browser TTS
commits.body: Introduce a hands-free realtime voice flow and browser-driven TTS. Server: add transcribe-only handling (flush transcript without routing to Claude), socket handlers to switch mode, start/send/flush streaming TTS, and cleanup/guards (drop audio for inactive sessions, VAD init guard). Client: new useRealtimeVoice hook to manage VoiceClient + AudioEngine lifecycle, streaming transcript callbacks, TTS send/flush/cancel, keyboard shortcuts, and speaking/mute state. UI: add VoiceStatusBar component and integrate realtime mode into ChatInterface (start/stop realtime voice, TTS sentence buffering, barge-in behavior). AudioEngine: support separate playback sample rate, mic support check, continuous capture (start/pause/resume/stop), analyser node, and playback resampling fixes. VoiceClient: expose setMode and TTS control methods. These changes enable secure, low-latency transcribe-only input with browser TTS playback and cleaner session handling.
